schema_learning: Process appearance guards reduced literal tree imagery across all outputs, but negative resemblance lists can redirect generation into adjacent clichés such as circuit lines. Positive permitted signatures must dominate exclusions. Functional camera/frame carriers remain strongest; long decorative seams and lighting-dependent embedded fields are unreliable.
